subject.title: feat: add private AWS workspace service

question: Should Crabbox add this dedicated AWS-only workspace service to core, provided its AWS-specific orchestration is moved behind the provider adapter and live acceptance passes?
rationale: This is a large new API and deployment mode with permanent configuration and operating commitments; code review can define safety requirements, but project owners must accept the core product surface.

options.title: Accept after adapter refactor
options.body: Keep the service in core, requiring provider-boundary repairs and authenticated AWS acceptance before merge.

options.title: Narrow to reusable capabilities
options.body: Merge only generic coordinator and provider hooks now, deferring the dedicated deployment and API product surface.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Leave the PR unmerged until maintainers want to support the dedicated service operationally.

recommendation.title: Accept after adapter refactor
recommendation.body: Keep the service in core, requiring provider-boundary repairs and authenticated AWS acceptance before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns most of the current AWS and Node coordinator history and is best positioned to decide whether this service belongs in core.
